%%sql
WITH trx AS (
SELECT sc.taxcode,sc.description, st.servizio,
    CASE WHEN st.servizio = 'gpd-payments/api/v1' OR st.servizio_pof = 'gpd-payments/api/v1' THEN
        'async'
    ELSE
        'sync'
    END as tipoT
from pagopa.enti sc right join pagopa.transaction_raw gp on sc.taxcode = gp.pa_fiscal_code
left join pagopa.stazioni st on partner_station = id_stazione
where
product = 'prod-pagopa' AND
origin IN ('SELC', 'PDND_INFOCAMERE') AND
institutiontype IN ('PRV', 'GPU')
AND sc.notificationtype='UPDATE'
and gp.daily >= '20241001' and gp.daily<'20250101')
SELECT taxcode,description,tipoT,count(*)
FROM trx
GROUP BY taxcode,description,tipoT
ORDER BY 1

%%sql
 
SELECT sc.taxcode,sc.description, count(*)
from pagopa.enti sc inner join pagopa.transaction_raw gp on sc.taxcode = gp.pa_fiscal_code
inner join pagopa.stazioni on partner_station = id_stazione
where
product = 'prod-pagopa' AND
origin IN ('SELC', 'PDND_INFOCAMERE') AND
institutiontype IN ('PRV', 'GPU')
AND sc.notificationtype='UPDATE'
and gp.daily >= '20250401' --and gp.daily<'20250401'
group by sc.taxcode,sc.description;
